headlines.title: Iran: Zionist regime poses gravest threat to Lebanon’s independence, stability
headlines.snippet: Tehran, IRNA – Iran's Foreign Ministry has strongly condemned the Israeli aggression against Lebanon, stating that the attacks—coinciding with the country's Independence Day— show the Zionist regime poses the greatest threat to its independence, territorial integrity, and stability.

headlines.snippet: London, IRNA – Iran has been elected to the Executive Board of the Special Program Trust Fund of the Global Framework on Chemicals (GFC) under the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) for a three-year term, representing the Asia-Pacific regional group.

headlines.snippet: Tehran, IRNA — The Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) Navy Public Relations announced that two violating oil tankers exploded on the unauthorized route of the Strait of Hormuz.

headlines.title: Violating oil tanker catches fire east of Strait of Hormuz
headlines.snippet: TEHRAN, Nov. 25 (MNA) – The Iranian Army Navy reported a fire aboard an oil tanker east of the Strait of Hormuz, stating that the vessel was immobilized after striking a naval mine.

headlines.title: “How many drones and ships did you lose today?”
headlines.snippet: TEHRAN, Nov. 25 (MNA) – Destroying a number of US vessels and drones in recent days, a spokesman for the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps (IRGC) mocked the US Central Command (CENTCOM), saying it how many ships and drones did you lose?

headlines.title: LNG carrier strikes sea mine, explodes in Hormuz: IRGC
headlines.snippet: TEHRAN, Nov. 25 (MNA) – The IRGC said Wednesday evening that an LNG carrier struck a naval mine and exploded in the Strait of Hormuz after switching off its positioning system and taking an unsafe route.

headlines.title: How did Iran change the power equation in region?
headlines.snippet: TEHRAN, Nov. 25 (MNA) – Iran has upended a core US assumption: that its military bases in West Asia guarantee security. By raising the cost of America’s presence, Tehran has forced Washington to rethink its regional strategy.

headlines.title: Iran Army has imposed stricter control over Hormuz Strait
headlines.snippet: TEHRAN, Nov. 25 (MNA) – Iran’s Army spokesman has said the military has enhanced its readiness and tightened control over the Strait of Hormuz, noting that the US continues to pursue military, political and economic pressure against Iran.

headlines.title: 1 Iran develops new ballistic missile variants, US think tanks say
headlines.snippet: Iran appears to be developing new ballistic missile variants designed to improve its ability to strike targets and evade air defenses, even as its capacity for mass production remains unclear, two US think tanks said on Tuesday.

headlines.title: 2 Iran’s rial falls past 2.85 million to the dollar
headlines.snippet: The US dollar broke through 2.85 million rials on Iran’s open market on Tuesday, deepening a currency crisis driven by soaring inflation, a US naval blockade that has choked oil exports and mounting US financial pressure.

headlines.title: 3 INSIGHT Persian Gulf oil exports near prewar levels despite Hormuz attacks
headlines.snippet: Oil exports from Persian Gulf producers outside Iran have nearly returned to prewar levels despite attacks on shipping in the Strait of Hormuz, with Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates surpassing their prewar crude and condensate export volumes, Kpler data show.

headlines.title: 4 Iranian media walk back tanker convoy claims after days of blockade-breaking hype
headlines.snippet: Iranian state media and officials have denied that Iran was about to send tankers through the US naval blockade, after four days in which Guards-linked outlets, lawmakers and Friday prayer leaders spread the claim and AI-generated images showed ships breaking through.

headlines.title: 5 INSIGHT Iran faces year-end cash squeeze if US blockade holds
headlines.snippet: Dwindling oil receipts and new US sanctions on Iran’s shadow banking networks could deepen Tehran’s foreign-currency squeeze in December.
